content: Taken together, these experiments provide evidence that CRAFT uses its capacity to model conversational context in an order-sensitive fashion, and that it makes effective use of the dynamics within. An important avenue for future work would be developing more transparent models that can shed light on exactly what kinds of order-related features are being extracted and how they are used in prediction.
